description: Preview of a web address: site icon, domain, title, description and thumbnail, with the whole card as the link.

howToUse: Pass what you already have about the page; the component never fetches the address to fill the card.
Without `favicon`, it shows the first letter of the domain instead of calling a third-party icon service.
Opens in a new tab by default and tells screen readers so.
alternatives: A source inside a sentence: Citation.
An item with price and actions: EntityCard.
